entity_types.name: Government
entity_types.description: Sovereign monetary/fiscal authorities and national administrations moving gold
entity_types.selection_rule: Any sovereign government body, central bank, ministry or national administration whose policy or reserve actions causally affect the gold price
anti_examples: IMF (data institution, unless acting as policy actor)
levers: impose or lift tariffs and sanctions

attributes.name: jurisdiction
attributes.description: Country or economic area the authority governs

entity_types.name: Organization
entity_types.description: Market institutions: data publishers, benchmark administrators, ETFs, banks
entity_types.selection_rule: A named non-governmental organization (data provider, ETF issuer, bank, exchange) with a distinct role in the gold market; mark data/news publishers as tier-3 in attributes
anti_examples: pure price series without an institutional actor
levers: publish price targets and scenario research

attributes.name: influence_tier
attributes.description: high/medium/low influence on gold price formation

attributes.name: simulation_tier_hint
attributes.description: 3 for passive data/news publishers (WGC, CFTC, IMF, CGA); 1-2 for market participants

entity_types.name: Other
entity_types.description: Trader blocs and position-taking collectives in gold futures markets
entity_types.selection_rule: Aggregated trader categories or unattributed market blocs whose positioning moves the price but which are not single institutions

attributes.name: current_position
attributes.description: Latest positioning (e.g. net long contracts, direction of weekly change)

entity_types.name: Platform
entity_types.description: Prediction-market and trading platforms pricing event outcomes
entity_types.selection_rule: Electronic market/prediction platforms where participants price macro outcomes relevant to gold

attributes.name: key_contract
attributes.description: Flagship contract relevant to gold macro (e.g. US recession by end-2027)

entity_types.name: GoldInstrument
entity_types.description: Tradeable/priceable gold objects: spot benchmark, ETFs, futures
entity_types.selection_rule: The specific price-bearing instruments the forecast resolves on or cross-checks against

attributes.name: resolving_role
attributes.description: Whether this is the resolving instrument, a flow proxy or a horizon anchor

entity_types.name: MacroSignal
entity_types.description: Trackable macro indicators driving gold: real yields, CPI, dollar, rates odds
entity_types.selection_rule: Concrete, time-stamped numeric series used as signposts (TIPS yield, CPI, DXY, breakevens, Fed odds)

attributes.name: latest_value
attributes.description: Latest observed value and observation period

attributes.name: thresholds
attributes.description: Scenario-discriminating thresholds tied to this signal

entity_types.name: MarketEvent
entity_types.description: Dated catalysts: FOMC meetings, elections, data releases, conflicts
entity_types.selection_rule: Specific dated events on the 2026-2027 calendar that can shift gold's price or premia

attributes.name: discriminates_scenario
attributes.description: Which scenario (Base/Bull/Bear/Range) the event's outcome separates

entity_types.name: GoldSupplier
entity_types.description: Mine producers and recyclers supplying physical gold to the market
entity_types.selection_rule: Named mining companies or supplier groups whose output changes physical supply

attributes.name: output_trend
attributes.description: Direction and scale of y/y output change

edge_types.name: INFLUENCES
edge_types.description: Source's policy or actions shape target's behavior or price outcomes
edge_types.direction_semantics: source exerts influence over target (e.g. Fed policy shapes ETF flows or trader positioning)

attributes.name: sentiment
attributes.description: Direction of current influence on gold: supportive/oppressive/neutral

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: Transmission channel (real yields, risk premium, flows)

edge_types.name: COMPETES_WITH
edge_types.description: Strategic rivalry between monetary powers or competing forecasters
edge_types.direction_semantics: source competes with or rivals target (e.g. PBoC vs US administration; JPM vs Polymarket pricing)

attributes.name: domain
attributes.description: Arena of competition: reserve-currency dominance / forecast credibility

edge_types.name: SANCTIONS
edge_types.description: Imposition of sanctions constraining target's gold flows
edge_types.direction_semantics: source sanctions target (e.g. US administration sanctions Russia's central bank)

attributes.name: impact_on_gold_flows
attributes.description: Effect on official-sector buying/selling (e.g. forced liquidation)

edge_types.name: CUSTOMER_OF
edge_types.description: Source consumes data/services published by target
edge_types.direction_semantics: source is a customer/consumer of target's data or services

attributes.name: service
attributes.description: Data or service consumed (demand surveys, reserve statistics)

edge_types.name: SUPPLIES
edge_types.description: Source supplies physical or positional gold exposure to target
edge_types.direction_semantics: source supplies gold (physical or via market) to target (e.g. Turkey's CB sales reaching traders; miners supplying market)

attributes.name: volume
attributes.description: Quantity supplied (tonnes or contracts) where known

edge_types.name: PARTNERS_WITH
edge_types.direction_semantics: source cooperates or aligns institutionally with target

attributes.name: purpose
attributes.description: e.g. reserve diversification coordination, data/benchmark partnership

edge_types.name: DEPENDS_ON
edge_types.description: Source's forecasts or operations rely on target's policy or data
edge_types.direction_semantics: source depends on target (e.g. bank forecasts depend on Fed path; GLD depends on LBMA benchmark)

edge_types.name: ACCUMULATES
edge_types.description: Source buys, holds or liquidates gold reserves/holdings
edge_types.direction_semantics: source accumulates (or, with negative volume, sells) the gold instrument/reserves

attributes.name: net_tonnes
attributes.description: Net purchases/sales in tonnes YTD or per period

attributes.name: target_holdings
attributes.description: Stated target or current holdings (e.g. Poland 700t target)

edge_types.name: CAUSES
edge_types.description: Causal transmission from a signal or policy to price/flow outcomes
edge_types.direction_semantics: source causes or transmits a shock to target (e.g. real-yield rise causes gold price pressure)

edge_types.name: TRIGGERS
edge_types.description: An event triggers a policy action, flow shift or scenario branch
edge_types.direction_semantics: source event triggers target action or outcome (e.g. Iran war triggering Turkish gold sales; recession triggering Fed easing)

attributes.name: probability
attributes.description: Market-implied or estimated probability where available

analysis_summary: 该预测问题是黄金价格预测（2027年12月31日LBMA/COMEX现货收盘价），核心张力在于：鹰派美联储与创纪录高位的实际利率（10年期TIPS 2.638%）对阵异常坚实的实物需求底线（央行购金Q2创纪录289吨、ETF持仓创纪录4256吨）。本体保留了actor阵容的种子类型（Government×9、Organization×7、Other、Platform），并新增4个领域类型：GoldInstrument（LBMA基准/COMEX期货/GLD等标的客体）、MacroSignal（实际收益率、CPI、美元指数、Fed概率等可追踪信号）、MarketEvent（FOMC会议、选举日历、伊朗战争等催化剂）和GoldSupplier（矿山供应方）。关系在保留7条实证边（INFLUENCES、COMPETES_WITH、SANCTIONS、CUSTOMER_OF、SUPPLIES、PARTNERS_WITH、DEPENDS_ON）基础上新增3条高判别力边：ACCUMULATES（官方部门购金/售金流，带净吨位与目标属性）、CAUSES（宏观信号→价格的因果传导，带sign/strength/lag，如高盛~$120/oz per 50bp敏感性）、TRIGGERS（事件→政策/仓位行动，带概率与时滞）。数据发布方（WGC、CFTC、IMF、CGA）按Organization标注为tier-3被动信息源，不作为能动决策主体，除非其行动直接推动结局。
